title: Launchers pinned to specific activity move different launchers on other activities
line: Reordering launchers on one activity no longer moves the launchers pinned to other activities.
explanation: After a launcher is moved, TasksModel::syncLaunchers() writes the new order back to the saved launcher list. It put the launchers shown on the current activity first, in their new order, and appended every launcher not shown there (those pinned to other activities) at the end, so each move on one activity pushed other activities' launchers to the far right. Now each hidden launcher is kept right after the nearest launcher before it that is visible wherever it is (e.g. one on all activities), or at the start if there is none, so its place among the launchers of its own activity is unchanged.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: keep launchers of other activities in place

Moving a launcher put every launcher hidden on the current activity at
the end of the list, so launchers pinned to other activities lost their
place. Each one now stays right after the launcher it used to follow.

BUG: 484219

media.caption: Master. Rows: Default activity (Konsole is Default-only, 3rd); Second activity (Info Center is Second-only); Second after dragging Info Center to the far left; back on Default, Konsole has jumped to the end.
With the fix, same steps: after moving Info Center on Second, Konsole stays 3rd on Default.
